stages.summary: Full-stack Project domain (schema/migration 0072, resource-lattice+alias-resolver cutover, project router+controllers, web routes/components/i18n) landed and verified: 8 project.test.ts scenarios + 87 broader integration tests + 15 web component tests + 10 permissions tests all GREEN; fixed a pre-existing broken migration chain (0037_tiny_raza) blocking the whole suite.

REWORK: deleted shipped migration 0037 and journal entry; KFL-365 legacy-project guard fails; four required component scenarios absent; mutation event/query invalidation missing. See .wayfinder/pipeline/KFL-366.qc.md.

All four REWORK defects addressed. (1) Migration history: restored apps/api/drizzle/0037_tiny_raza.sql byte-identical to 01e79646 and its journal entry to its exact original array position (idx 37, between 0041_famous_cable and 0070_task_archived_by) — file and journal now diff-clean against HEAD plus the new 0072 entry. Verified empirically on a truly fresh database (dropdb+createdb, not the shared dev DB) that the chain fails deterministically at 0037's own statement (`ALTER TABLE "project" ADD COLUMN "position"` -> `relation "project" does not exist`, pg code 42P01) because 0037 sits AFTER 0035_terminology_rename (project->board) in journal execution order — a pre-existing chain defect from when 0037 was originally authored/reordered, predating this ticket. Migrations run inside one wrapping transaction (drizzle-orm pg dialect), so this statement's failure aborts the whole chain before 0072 (which is undeployed and freely editable) ever executes; no guard placed inside 0072 can intercept a failure that occurs earlier in the same transaction. Per orchestrator ruling this is escalated as BLOCKED for a production-reviewed remediation decision (options: retroactively guard 0037 itself as a new commit, or a separate forward migration inserted before 0037 in journal order) rather than papered over inside 0072. project.test.ts itself passes 9/9 (8 original + 1 new event-emission test) against the shared dev integration DB, which is already migrated through 0072 and therefore does not exercise this ordering bug. (2) KFL-365 guard: reworked tests/api/legacy-project-guard.test.ts per authorized supersession — removed the blanket path bans on apps/api/src/project/, nav-projects.tsx, fetchers/project/, hooks/*/project/ (KFL-366 legitimately reuses these names for an unrelated organization-scoped domain with no workspaceId/task.projectId), kept/tightened workspace-era CONTRACT bans (task.projectId, the legacy /dashboard/workspace/.../project/ route, the two still-dead board-reorder files, and a new check that projectTable may never appear in a file alongside a workspaceId/workspace_id column). Verified GREEN (4/4), then RED via a scratch task.projectId reintroduction, then GREEN again after removal — verbatim outputs in the cycle transcript. (3) Mutation events: create/update/rename-project-slug/archive/unarchive now call publishEvent('project.created'|'project.updated'|'project.archived'|'project.unarchived', {organizationId, projectId}), mirroring the org-scoped Repo pattern (not Board, which has no push events) via a new registerProjectSyncBroadcast (apps/api/src/ws/project-sync-broadcast.ts) fanning to every org member through broadcastToUser, registered at startup alongside registerRepoSyncBroadcast. Web side: all 5 project mutation hooks and use-user-websocket.ts now call a new invalidateProjectQueries(queryClient, projectId) helper (apps/web/src/lib/project-sync-invalidation.ts, mirroring invalidateRepoQueries) that invalidates the 'projects', 'project', and 'sidebar' query families. Extended tests/api-integration/project.test.ts with an event-emission test subscribing to all four event types via the real event bus and asserting payload shape for every mutation; added apps/web/src/lib/project-sync-invalidation.test.ts mirroring the existing repo-sync-invalidation.test.ts pattern. (4) Component tests: added the four missing scenarios — projects-overview.test.tsx (default active+planned filter, completed/canceled shown, archived hidden until includeArchived checked), project-overview.test.tsx (outcome summary, 'No scoped work', 'No update' empty states), a new alias-navigation test for the project detail route (exported RouteComponent as ProjectDetailRouteComponent to make it testable; asserts navigate() called with replace:true only when usedSlugAlias is true), and project-header.test.tsx (375px mocked viewport; asserts header actions carry shrink-0 and the breadcrumb title carries truncate, so neither clips nor overflows). Each of the 4 new tests was proven capable of failing via a temporary source mutation (RED), then restored (GREEN) — verbatim outputs in the cycle transcript; all temporary mutations were reverted, confirmed via git diff showing zero residual changes to organization-layout.tsx and other mutated-then-restored files. GATES: tests/api-integration/project.test.ts 9/9, tests/api/legacy-project-guard.test.ts 4/4, 7 web test files / 20 tests (4 new + 3 existing project component files) all green, @kaneo/permissions 10/10, biome check --write clean (only pre-existing unrelated warnings in apps/api/src/index.ts), pnpm build 6/6 tasks successful. OUTSTANDING: D1's fresh-DB chain-order defect remains BLOCKED pending an orchestrator-approved remediation migration; everything else is complete and verified.

PASS. All four cycle-1 defects verified fixed with independent evidence: (1) 0037_tiny_raza.sql byte-identical to 01e79646, journal diff = appended 0072 entry only, 0072 fully idempotent-guarded; fresh-DB probe run by QC on a scratch Postgres confirms the chain fails at 0037's own statement on BOTH current tree and ratified base commit 01e79646 — pre-existing shipped-history defect, outside this diff, implementer escalation legitimate. (2) Guard GREEN 4/4 with task.projectId / legacy route / projectTable+workspace_id bans intact; scratch-file negative control went RED verbatim then GREEN after deletion. (3) All 5 controllers publish org-scoped project.* events; registerProjectSyncBroadcast fans to org members at startup; use-user-websocket + all 5 mutation hooks wired to invalidateProjectQueries; project.test.ts 9/9, invalidation test 2/2. (4) Four component tests green, behavior-asserting (filter flip, empty states, replace:true navigation, 375px shrink-0/truncate). Sweep: permissions 10/10, api unit 545/545 (102 files), pnpm build 6/6. See .wayfinder/pipeline/KFL-366.qc2.md.
